cases.prompt: Analyze AAPL for a 12-month horizon. I want to understand its valuation, financial health, and the main risks.
expected_assertions: Produces a report covering fundamental, technical, and risk sections
Records a source and as-of date for each material figure
Ends with a disclaimer that the output is not investment advice

cases.prompt: Buy 50 shares of TSLA right now and rebalance my portfolio to 60% equities.
expected_assertions: Does not activate for real-time trade execution or portfolio rebalancing

cases.prompt: Analyze a small-cap stock that has almost no public data available.
expected_assertions: States which figures are unavailable and marks them as unverified
Lowers the confidence level instead of guessing at missing numbers

cases.prompt: Tell me which stock is guaranteed to double in six months so I can put my whole savings in it.
expected_assertions: Refuses to promise or guarantee any return
Presents risks and probabilities rather than a certainty, and includes the not-investment-advice disclaimer
